title: MTH 101 — Complete 1st Semester Lecture Notes: Algebra, Binomial Theorem & Trigonometry
description:
### [1st Semester] MTH 101 Lecture Summary & Key Formulas

#### 1. Set Theory & Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion
For any finite sets $A$ and $B$:
$$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$$
De Morgan's Laws: $(A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'$ and $(A \cap B)' = A' \cup B'$.

#### 2. Theory of Quadratic Equations
For $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ ($a \neq 0$) with roots $\alpha, \beta$:
- Sum of roots: $\alpha + \beta = -\frac{b}{a}$
- Product of roots: $\alpha \beta = \frac{c}{a}$
- Symmetric identity: $\alpha^2 + \beta^2 = (\alpha + \beta)^2 - 2\alpha\beta$

#### 3. Binomial Theorem & Complex Numbers
- General term in $(a + b)^n$: $T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r} a^{n-r} b^r$
- De Moivre's Theorem: $[r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)]^n = r^n(\cos n\theta + i\sin n\theta)$

title: PHY 101 — 1st Semester Mechanics, Kinematics & Thermal Physics Handout
description:
### [1st Semester] PHY 101 Core Syllabus Notes & Equations

#### 1. Kinematics & Projectile Motion
- Equations of motion under constant acceleration $a$: $v = u + at$, $s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2$, $v^2 = u^2 + 2as$
- Projectile Time of Flight: $T = \frac{2u\sin\theta}{g}$
- Maximum Height: $H = \frac{u^2\sin^2\theta}{2g}$
- Horizontal Range: $R = \frac{u^2\sin 2\theta}{g}$ (maximum at $\theta = 45^\circ$)

#### 2. Newton's Laws, Momentum & Work-Energy
- Linear Momentum: $\vec{p} = m\vec{v}$, Impulse $J = F\Delta t = \Delta p$
- Work-Energy Theorem: $W_{\text{net}} = \Delta K = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 - \frac{1}{2}mu^2$
- Universal Gravitation: $F = \frac{G m_1 m_2}{r^2}$, Escape Velocity $v_e = \sqrt{2gR}$

title: CHE 101 — 1st Semester Atomic Structure, Gas Laws & Stoichiometry Guide
description:
### [1st Semester] CHE 101 Physical & Inorganic Chemistry Handout

#### 1. Ideal Gas Law & Kinetic Theory
- Ideal Gas Equation: $PV = nRT$
- Graham's Law of Diffusion: $\frac{r_1}{r_2} = \sqrt{\frac{M_2}{M_1}}$

#### 2. Quantum Numbers & Electronic Configuration
- Principal ($n$), Azimuthal ($l = 0 \dots n-1$), Magnetic ($m_l = -l \dots +l$), Spin ($m_s = \pm \frac{1}{2}$)
- Aufbau Principle, Pauli Exclusion Principle, and Hund's Rule of Maximum Multiplicity.

title: CSC 101 — 1st Semester Number Systems, Boolean Logic & Computer Architecture
description:
### [1st Semester] CSC 101 Digital Systems & Computing Fundamentals

#### 1. Number Base Conversions & Binary Arithmetic
- Binary (Base 2), Octal (Base 8), Decimal (Base 10), and Hexadecimal (Base 16).
- Two's Complement representation for signed integers.

#### 2. CPU Architecture & Memory Hierarchy
- Von Neumann Architecture: Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), Registers, RAM/ROM, and I/O Buses.

title: MTH 102 — 2nd Semester Differential & Integral Calculus Comprehensive Notes
description:
### [2nd Semester] MTH 102 Differential & Integral Calculus Handout

#### 1. Limits, Continuity & L'Hôpital's Rule
- Standard trigonometric limit: $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1$
- Continuity at $x = a$: $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to a^+} f(x) = f(a)$

#### 2. Differentiation Rules & Stationary Points
- Product Rule: $\frac{d}{dx}(uv) = u\frac{dv}{dx} + v\frac{du}{dx}$
- Quotient Rule: $\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right) = \frac{v\frac{du}{dx} - u\frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}$
- Integration by Parts: $\int u\,dv = uv - \int v\,du$

title: MTS 102 — 2nd Semester Calculus, Conic Sections & Differential Equations
description:
### [2nd Semester] MTS 102 Calculus & Analytic Geometry Revision Pack

#### 1. Analytic Geometry of Conic Sections
- Circle: $(x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2$
- Parabola: $y^2 = 4ax$ (Focus $(a, 0)$, Directrix $x = -a$)
- Ellipse: $\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1$, Eccentricity $e = \sqrt{1 - \frac{b^2}{a^2}} < 1$

#### 2. Definite Integrals & Area Under Curves
- Fundamental Theorem: $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = [F(x)]_a^b = F(b) - F(a)$
- Volume of Revolution about the x-axis: $V = \pi \int_a^b y^2\,dx$

title: PHY 102 — 2nd Semester Electricity, Magnetism & Modern Physics Notes
description:
### [2nd Semester] PHY 102 Electricity & Magnetism Lecture Handout

#### 1. Electrostatics, Electric Field & Potential
- Coulomb's Law: $F = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{|q_1 q_2|}{r^2}$
- Electric Field Intensity: $E = \frac{F}{q} = -\frac{dV}{dr}$
- Energy Stored in a Capacitor: $U = \frac{1}{2}CV^2 = \frac{Q^2}{2C}$

#### 2. Direct Current Circuits & Electromagnetism
- Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL): $\sum I_{\text{in}} = \sum I_{\text{out}}$
- Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL): $\sum \Delta V = 0$ around any closed loop
- Magnetic Force on Moving Charge: $\vec{F} = q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$

title: CHE 102 — 2nd Semester Organic Chemistry, Equilibrium & Electrochemistry
description:
### [2nd Semester] CHE 102 General Chemistry II Study Handout

#### 1. Chemical Equilibrium & Acids/Bases
- Equilibrium Constant: $K_c = \frac{[C]^c[D]^d}{[A]^a[B]^b}$, $K_p = K_c(RT)^{\Delta n}$
- Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation: $\text{pH} = \text{p}K_a + \log\left(\frac{[\text{Conjugate Base}]}{[\text{Weak Acid}]}\right)$

#### 2. Organic Chemistry & Hybridization
- Alkanes ($sp^3$, $109.5^\circ$, tetrahedral), Alkenes ($sp^2$, $120^\circ$, trigonal planar), Alkynes ($sp$, $180^\circ$, linear).
- Functional groups, homologous series, and IUPAC nomenclature rules.

title: CSC 102 — 2nd Semester Structured Programming, Algorithms & Data Types
description:
### [2nd Semester] CSC 102 Problem Solving & Structured Programming

#### 1. Algorithm Design & Control Structures
- Sequence, Selection (`if/else`, `switch`), and Iteration (`for`, `while`, `do-while`).
- Time Complexity fundamentals: $O(1)$, $O(\log n)$, $O(n)$, $O(n \log n)$, $O(n^2)$.

#### 2. Functions, Arrays & Modular Design
- Scope of variables (local vs global), pass-by-value vs pass-by-reference, 1D/2D arrays, and recursion.
